name: Red Cross Cubing Open 2017

venue.name: Franklin High School
venue.details: We will be located in the High School cafeteria. Parking is available at the back entrance of the school. Upon entering,

information: This competition is a fundraiser which will support the American Red Cross. All competitors must pre-register via Paypal. There is a flat fee of $20 and a competitor limit of 150. Walk-in competitors will not be permitted, no exceptions.
